places.displayName: Teatr Morskie Oko, Jasna 3 / Sienkiewicza 7, Warsaw
places.publicNote: Warsaw revue theatre associated with Kaper’s early popular-song environment. Morskie Oko occupied the corner of Jasna 3 and Sienkiewicza 7 from 1928 to 1933; that historical venue address is used for the map.
